title: Activism for everyone
slide_intent: Show how to leave a symbol simple enough for a participant to draw. A few memorable strokes let people contribute without production tools.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give partners and communities a way to express participation on a wall, placard or other informal surface.
demonstration: A numbered three-stroke drawing sits beside two photographs of the figure drawn large on walls. The guidance distinguishes these marks from the official logo.
practical_value: Offer the three-stroke sequence for participation and reserve the supplied mark for formal brand identification.

content_islands.spec: Place the invitation and the note about official usage together in the left text column.

content_islands.spec: Show the figure below the explanation with three pink numbers and guides indicating the order of the strokes.

content_islands.spec: Stack two documentary photographs at right. Show the drawn symbol in each physical setting and retain surrounding details that indicate scale.
